scope: Bounded authenticated public birth observation and native read consistency. No physical repair, runtime activation or deployment qualification claim.

repository_reproducer.case: returns the original expired key, epoch and deadline without writes or seed reads

causal_profile.old_result: A verified migration request cannot observe the original public key, epoch and deadline of an existing preparation; the old handler returns no response for this read.
causal_profile.required_result: The distinct authenticated descriptor read returns the original expired preparation metadata without native writes or seed/key reads. Old command and status encodings remain unchanged.
causal_profile.old_to_new_envelope_mapping: Same retained records, source keys, client profile and configured workload resource envelopes. New observation has only clock/record/marker reads; ordinary admission remains fenced.

frozen.provenance_note: Both probes statically link the unchanged pre-edit Cabal package. Frozen-closing was linked after tracked source edits but before any package rebuild; it exercises the same pre-edit compiled library, not the then-edited source.
